$description: CSS-native token values: values with no DTCG type, declared by hand in *.native.css files. Each entry says why it cannot be a DTCG token. build-css-from-dtcg.mjs --check fails on an unlisted declaration or a stale entry. See docs/design-system/token-single-source.md.

values.--a63-action-control-gloss: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-action-control-highlight: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-action-control-press-transform: A CSS transform (translateY / scale); DTCG has no transform type.
values.--a63-choice-indicator-gloss: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-control-gloss: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-control-highlight: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-control-press-transform: A CSS transform (translateY / scale); DTCG has no transform type.
values.--a63-overlay-backdrop: A backdrop-filter value (default none, blur in translucent themes); DTCG has no filter type.
values.--a63-overlay-gloss: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-overlay-highlight: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-overlay-texture-blend: A mix-blend-mode keyword; DTCG has no blend-mode type.
values.--a63-overlay-texture-image: A background-image texture (default none); DTCG has no image type.
values.--a63-surface-backdrop: A backdrop-filter value (default none, blur in translucent themes); DTCG has no filter type.
values.--a63-surface-gloss: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-surface-highlight: A background-image layer (default none, a gradient in glossy themes); DTCG has no image or gradient type.
values.--a63-surface-texture-blend: A mix-blend-mode keyword; DTCG has no blend-mode type.
values.--a63-surface-texture-image: A background-image texture (default none); DTCG has no image type.
values.--a63-trigger-indicator-size: Sized in em, relative to the trigger's font size; DTCG dimensions are px or rem only.
